welcome:
Welcome to EcoTrace AI!
I am your offline nature scout. What would you like to identify today?
help: Use Text ID to describe what you found, or Photo ID to send a clear photo. Include your location and any distinctive details when you can. AI identifications can be wrong, so never touch or eat an unfamiliar wild plant or animal.
photo_help: Send a clear photo of the plant, animal, track, or other nature feature. You can add a question or your location in the caption.
text_help: Describe what you found and where you found it. Include details such as size, color, shape, and habitat.
processing_photo: Analyzing your nature photo... please wait.
error_ai: Sorry, my compass is broken. Please try again later.
